metadata.scenario: A caller requests information about the company's operating hours during the holiday season. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Michael Brown. I found your number through the hospital's discharge planning department. Hi, Michael! It's great to hear from you. How can I assist you today? Well, my father has diabetes and needs wound care and medication management. I understand, and we can certainly help with that. Are you interested in our services? Yes, but I wanted to check your operating hours during the holiday season first. Of course! Our hours remain consistent during the holidays. We remain open Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 7 PM. What about weekends? On Saturdays, we're open from 8 AM to 5 PM, and Sundays are for on-call emergencies only. That sounds manageable. So, if I need to schedule a visit, would I be able to do that on a Saturday? Yes, absolutely! We can schedule services on Saturdays. Just let us know what you need. Great! I just want to ensure my father receives proper care. I completely understand. We can provide skilled nursing care, wound care management, and medication management for him. How much do those services usually cost? For skilled nursing care, the price ranges from $95 to $125, depending on the duration. And for medication management? Medication management is priced between $65 and $80 for a 30-45 minute visit. Perfect, that fits within what I was expecting. Excellent! Would you like me to connect you with our Care Coordinator to discuss a care plan? Yes, that would be helpful. Great! Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, is available. Would you like me to transfer you? Yes, please do. One moment please, I'll transfer you now. Thank you, Margaret. You're welcome, Michael! I hope we can help your father soon. Transferring now... [Transfer sound] [End of call]
